map.起飞跑道长度修正计算：根据机场海拔、气温、跑道坡度对基准长度进行修正: Takeoff runway length correction: adjust the baseline length for airport elevation, air temperature and runway slope.
map.机型基准跑道长度 (m): Baseline runway length for the type (m)
map.：每高于海平面 300m（1000ft），跑道长度增加约 7%: : for every 300 m (1000 ft) above sea level, runway length increases by about 7%
map.：每高于 ISA 1°C，跑道长度增加约 1%: : for every 1°C above ISA, runway length increases by about 1%
map.：每 1% 上坡坡度，跑道长度增加约 10%: : for every 1% upslope, runway length increases by about 10%
map.：每 5 m/s（10kt）顶风，跑道长度减少约 7%: : for every 5 m/s (10 kt) of headwind, runway length decreases by about 7%
map.（可用着陆距离）：跑道可用于着陆的长度: (LDA): the length of runway available for landing
map.ISA 温度 = 15 − 0.0065 × 海拔(m)；修正长 = 基准长 ×: ISA temperature = 15 - 0.0065 × elevation (m); corrected length = baseline × weight factor × (1 + elevation/300 × 0.07) × (1 + max(0, dT) × 0.01) × (1 + slope × 0.10) × (1 - headwind/5 × 0.07); recommended length = corrected length × 1.15
map.海拔每高 300m 需加长 7%、高于 ISA 每 1℃ 加长 1%、上坡每 1: Every 300 m of elevation adds 7%, every 1°C above ISA adds 1%, every 1% upslope adds 10%, and every 5 m/s of headwind shortens it by 7% (up to 30%); then add a 15% safety margin.
map.本工具使用经验修正系数，仅用于教学估算。实际飞行计划须使用机型飞行手册（AFM）: This tool uses empirical correction factors for teaching estimation only. Actual flight planning must use the aircraft flight manual (AFM) performance charts.

map.高原/高温机场评估起飞重量限制（跑道不够则减载）。: Assess takeoff weight limits at high-elevation/high-temperature airports (reduce payload if the runway is too short).
map.对比湿跑道（摩擦降低）的额外长度需求。: Compare the extra length needed for a wet runway (lower friction).
map.某机型基准跑道 2500 m（海平面 ISA）。机场海拔 1500 m 密度高度: For a type with a 2500 m baseline runway at sea-level ISA: at an airport elevation of 1500 m the density-altitude correction is about +12%, a temperature 10°C above standard adds +6%, and a 1% slope adds +3%, totalling 2500×1.21≈3025 m. In practice follow the type performance manual correction tables.
map.为什么顶风可以缩短跑道？: Why can a headwind shorten the runway?
map.顶风提高地速达到离地空速的滑跑效率，等效缩短所需地面滑跑距离；顺风反之。性能计算: A headwind improves the ground-roll efficiency of reaching lift-off airspeed, effectively shortening the ground roll needed; a tailwind does the opposite. Performance calculations treat the headwind component as a negative correction.
map.湿跑道为什么要求更长？: Why does a wet runway require more length?
map.湿滑道面刹车与加速性能下降、中断起飞距离增大，需更长跑道或更严的重量限制。规章对: On a slippery surface braking and acceleration performance degrade and the rejected-takeoff distance grows, requiring a longer runway or stricter weight limits. Regulations apply specific performance discounts for wet/contaminated runways.
